name: I Was Told There Would Be
aka: I Was Told There Would Be Cake
look: A still from Office Space: Stephen Root as Milton, a man with large glasses, a mustache and reddish hair, sits at a cluttered cubicle desk in a short-sleeved striped shirt and dark tie, one hand on a red Swingline stapler, staring blankly ahead.
use: A meek complaint in Milton's voice that something promised never showed up. The top usually reads 'I was told there would be' and the bottom names the missing perk, like cake, snacks, a raise or a lunch break.
slots: top caption: 'I was told there would be'
bottom caption: the promised thing that never showed up
examples: I was told there would be
I was told there would be
a parking spot with my name on it
describe: nerdy office guy with glasses and a red stapler at his desk
man with mustache and big glasses sitting in a cubicle staring

origin: Stephen Root as Milton Waddams in the 1999 comedy film Office Space.
